description:
Housekeeping initiative (requested 2026-07-25, logged on Saturday rest day; execute in next active window). Standing goal: the workspace is kept clippy-clean and rustfmt-formatted, AND no Rust source line exceeds 80 characters. This is a NEW mandatory rule to be added ON TOP of the existing workspace rules (does not relax any of them: Android/Termux portability, no trait objects, no Box/lifetimes, release-mode builds, never-auto-commit/push, uom, doc-comments, V&V docs, token-accounting hooks).

Deliverable is a Rust binary 'outram-fmt' that runs the whole housekeeping pass and can also --check (non-mutating, CI-style gate).

Current scale (measured 2026-07-25): 6222 lines >80 chars across 1971 of 2246 tracked .rs files -> the actual reformat is large and MUST be coordinated with in-flight feature branches (blender, outram-foam agents active) to avoid a merge-conflict storm. Sequence the tooling+rule first; time the big reformat when branches are quiescent.
title: outram-fmt: workspace clippy + rustfmt + 80-char line-length tooling & rule

description:
Parent: op-841p. THE RUNG 3 TO RUNG 4 INTERFACE plus rung 4 itself. Wire to op-p6p.10 (genfoam pointKinetics reactivity-feedback + coupling layer, In Progress).

WHAT op-p6p.10 ALREADY LANDED: crates/outram-foam-appbuilder-lib/src/genfoam/multi_region/reactivity_feedback.rs. ReactivityFeedback turns mesh TH/TM fields (T_fuel, T_struct, rho_coolant) into a scalar delta-rho via importance-weighted (volume or phi-squared-worth) volume averaging. FeedbackTerm enum: Doppler (linear/log), Expansion, Density. NOT ported: GEM/control-rod driveline, external neutron source, FMU inputs, liquid-fuel precursor advection.

HAND-OFF MUST CARRY: beta_eff and Lambda collapsed from the flux solution, with the adjoint weighting used STATED; the reactivity coefficients; and rod worth versus insertion for comparison against B42.

THE HTR-10-SPECIFIC GAP: a SEPARATE graphite/moderator temperature-feedback channel (bead op-jyyp.6). Only lumped fuel feedback exists today. The graphite channel is central to HTR-10 loss-of-flow behaviour and must come down rung 3 as its own reactivity coefficient, NOT folded into Doppler.

RUNG 4 HOST: crates/teh-o-prke. Its decay heat was replaced 2026-08-11 with the 23-group 1978 draft ANS Standard fit (Tobias Table 16) covering U-235 thermal, U-238 fast and Pu-239 thermal, integrated analytically per group because lambda spans 15 orders of magnitude. crates/teh-o-prke/src/decay_heat.rs is the doc/test standard this whole pipeline should match: every test carries a Methodology paragraph stating the pass criterion BEFORE the number, then a dated Results paragraph with the measured value, and an explicit statement of what the test does NOT prove.

VALIDATION: rung 4 parameters vs those derived directly from the rung 3 flux solution, quoted as a relative difference, with the flux solution they were collapsed from recorded.
title: HTR-10 rung 3->4 seam + rung 4: collapse to PRKE parameters and decay heat
